_note: ASK_EVENTFLOW_V1 demo fixture for /dashboard?demo=1 (fictional The Harborview). Keyed by the three example-chip questions; anything else gets the fallback. Shape gated by patches/verify_demo_fixtures.js against patches/fixtures/ask_captured.json.

How many inquiries did we get last month.answer: The Harborview handled 23 separate guest inquiries in August 2026. Those came through as 27 emails in total, so a few conversations went back and forth. Five of the 23 inquiries were handed off to your events manager.
How many inquiries did we get last month.sql: select count(distinct thread_id) as inquiries, count(*) as emails, count(distinct thread_id) filter (where escalated) as escalated_inquiries from ask_inquiries where day >= date '2026-08-01' and day < date '2026-09-01'
How many inquiries did we get last month.explanation: Distinct guest conversations handled in August 2026, with the total emails and how many conversations were handed to your events manager.

Which event types asked most in August?.answer: Corporate events led August 2026 inquiries at The Harborview with 12 conversations. Birthday celebrations followed with 5, then rehearsal dinners with 3. Another 3 conversations came in without a stated event type. Note: event type is only recorded when the guest mentions one.
Which event types asked most in August?.sql: select coalesce(nullif(event_type, ''), 'not specified') as event_type, count(distinct thread_id) as inquiries, count(*) as emails from ask_inquiries where day >= date '2026-08-01' and day < date '2026-09-01' group by 1 order by inquiries desc limit 50
Which event types asked most in August?.explanation: Distinct conversations in August 2026 grouped by the event type the guest mentioned.
caveats: Event type is only filled in when the guest said one, so emails without a stated type show as not specified.

Show the leads we marked Lost and why.answer: Four pipeline leads at The Harborview are marked Lost. Two aged out when their event dates passed without a booking, one was turned down in your booking system, and one went quiet after the third automatic follow-up. Note: the venue does not record a reason when a lead is lost, so the reasons here come from the notes that were written at the time.
Show the leads we marked Lost and why.sql: select created_at::date as added, guest_name, company, event_type, event_date, guest_count, estimated_value, notes from ask_pipeline where stage = 'Lost' order by created_at desc limit 50
Show the leads we marked Lost and why.explanation: Pipeline leads currently in the Lost stage, newest first, with the notes written when they were marked.
caveats: The venue does not record a reason when a lead is lost; the notes column shows the automatic reason when one was written.
